best_hook.why: A scarred man bows to the shabby soldier in the woods and says 'Your Grace' - the secret-duke reveal in two words.

best_cliffhanger.why: 'Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to' - vengeance vow on a dramatic push-in; the reclaiming has not begun.

must_promos.why: 'Your Grace' opener, the usurper sitting in his father's chair, 'My mother is a prisoner in her own house', 'Everyone believes you are dead' / 'Let them believe it a little longer', ending on the vow - hidden-identity revenge setup in one take.

standalone_risk: The informant's report is dense with unexplained names (Lord Sterling, Rupert, Lady Catherine, Ashburg) and 'her' is unclear until 'My mother'; there is no on-screen villain, and the middle is talky exposition.
notes: Opening scene (ruins, villagers' kindness) and closing barn scene are quiet; only the forest meeting is promo material.
